touch_derivation: Bar open=100, high=104, low=85, close=95 with stop 90, TARGET-NEAR 105, TARGET-FAR 110 under raw_close_only_v1. Long: high 104 < 105 so neither target touches; low 85 <= 90 so the stop touches. Design 12:339 - only one class touches, so all three policies select it. Reference price: open 100 is not <= stop 90, low 85 <= 90, so the reference is the stop level 90 (design 10 table row 2, reproduced by the legacy raw evaluator at exits.py:400-406). Sell with slippage_bps 0: floor_to_price_tick(90, 1) = 90.
